borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Pruning of 2no. London Plane trees (T48  T50) located adjacent to the Care of Elderly Building, and subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/198/3/93.  Works to include: crown lifting and crown reduction to enable the lifting operations of the new plant and equipment onto the roof of Care of Elderly Building. As part of PSDS3c project for the Imperial College Health Trust, Dalkia Energy have employed lifting specialists to position the new heavy plant onto the roof. Due to the weight of this plant, the crane required to lift it is also large and it requires of substantial counterweight which has to be put into position by another smaller mobile crane. The lower branches of T48 and T50 are preventing a clear heigh for this mobile crane to operate safely, therefore we are asking for lifting to increase the clearance between the ground and the crown, plus to reducing the branches that are reaching out further away to obtain the clearance from the Care of Elderly Building facade.
